claim.scope_statement: For a smooth density proportional to exp(-V) on R^d with mI<=Hess V<=MI, m>0, h(mu)>=sqrt(2m/pi) and h(mu)sqrt(||Cov(mu)||op)>=sqrt(2/(pi(M/m))). Thus every fixed Hessian condition-number class satisfies the literal dimension-free bound.
